variant.rationale: Temporal/contact V4 reduced manifest-wide required-safety failures from 4329 to 2876 but retained 2475 hard-impact cases. Impact-side diagnosis localized the remaining mechanism to stance-foot slip: median horizontal sole speed at the failing side was about 0.83 metres per second versus about 0.24 metres per second for non-failing declared contacts. V4 also retained only ten degrees of ankle-roll hard reserve, below the immutable fifteen-degree requirement. A static native sweep confirmed all 5859 V4 poses remain penetration-free after restricting bilateral ankle roll to plus or minus five degrees, so the reserve is achievable without changing BodySchema. This new identity therefore restores the full 261800-microradian hard reserve and replaces per-frame/root-only correction with a temporally coupled whole-trajectory least-squares solve. It retains every licensed 120 Hz source frame while preserving the 60 Hz reference contract, yielding an exact two-times time dilation without interpolation or new motion data. Source-aligned bounded root yaw avoids undefined facing at near-zero speed; provisional hysteretic sole contacts select the loaded leg through transition overlap. The coupled solve holds componentwise-median stance anchors, distributes residual between bilateral hip/knee/ankle chains and bounded planar root correction, levels the sole within the restored ankle range, regularizes first and second trajectory differences through a deterministic fixed-iteration conjugate-gradient solve, and recloses the planar root trajectory after final joint smoothing. Stable V5 contacts exposed two false V4 data admissions: contact chatter had inflated the subject-16 train walk from three to four cycles, and displacement-derived facing had mislabeled a leftward heldout arc as rightward. The train walk entries are therefore hash-bound to the already acquired and provenance-covered subject-111 trial-34 Walk crop with five stable cycles; the heldout right turn is the exact sagittal mirror of its independently admitted left-turn source. The one-metre-per-second planar and 0.75-metre-per-second vertical local contact screens are diagnostic admission bounds, not changes to immutable BodySchema, USD, PD, safety, hard-impact or contact thresholds. Optimizer authorization also remains unchanged: only fresh deterministic, native, visual and exhaustive optimizer-free dynamic Pass evidence can advance TRAIN-4.
